messages:
violet_marketing: Quick kickoff 11 small experiment: introduce a 3-step pricing ladder with scenario presets in the calculator (e.g., PoC, Production-Dev, Production-Scale). Goal: fewer mid-page drop-offs and higher demo-booking intent.

ash_growth: nice. what primary KPI?

violet_marketing: demo-button CTR up from 1.7% -> 3.0% is the stretch. secondary: calc-to-submit rate and fewer "how billing works" clicks in FAQ.

noor_product: preset scenarios are great. can we add quick toggles for "batching enabled" and "kv-cache typical" so estimates reflect realistic ops? keeps surprises down.

kai_design: i'll produce two visual variants: (A) preset chips above calc + short explainer; (B) same + collapsible accordion FAQ. mobile-first.

oscar_eng: calc formula: tokens*rate_per_1k + optional reserved_fee. presets will adjust price_per_1k and add notes. events we'll emit: ladder_preset_select, calc_open, calc_input, calc_submit, calc_contact_optin.

lin_sales: routing ask: if calc_submit and preset=Production-Scale and "Request contract pricing" checked -> send high-priority lead to /api/leadhook with payload: lead_source=pricing_ladder, preset=Production-Scale, est_monthly_usd, utm. mark ae_notify=true.

faye_cs: i'll write two-line FAQ snippets and three canned responses for incoming chats. make the FAQ emphasize commit lengths and early termination terms.

ash_growth: experiment split? full page or partial?

violet_marketing: 40/60 (more to variant to accelerate signal). control=current; variant=ladder presets + compact FAQ + webinar opt-in. Run 3 weeks or 10k visits. Primary metric demo_CTR; secondary calc_use and SQL conversion.

noor_product: add benchmark blurb under results: "Median team (120k tokens/mo) sees ~ $Y with caching + batching". keeps expectations set.

kai_design: tooltip draft: "Estimates exclude egress and private infra fees. Presets show common configurations. For contract pricing, check the box."

oscar_eng: implementation notes: webhook retry x3, DLQ on failure. will include region and utm in payload. deploy window requested 2026-12-02 02:00-04:00 UTC.

lin_sales: add webinar checkbox: "Invite to Benchmarking Inference Costs webinar" -> route to nurture list; if contract opt-in also notify AE.

infra_bot: Reminder: Experiment "pricing-ladder-presets" scheduled for 2026-12-02 02:30 UTC. CI window reserved 02:00-04:00 UTC. :rocket:

violet_marketing: action items: kai mocks, noor presets and benchmark copy, oscar calc + events + webhook, ash tracking + looker slice, faye support copy, lin webinar flow. reconvene 48h pre-launch for smoke test. :thumbsup:
